A '''duel''' took place on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] between [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] and [[Tor Vizsla]]. During the fight, Vizsla injected Fett with a potent [[Poison/Legends|poison]] that caused him to become drowsy. However, before Vizsla could land a mortal blow, Fett wounded him with a slash to the stomach before succumbing to unconsciousness.
